scope: The lighthouse building at Split Rock in June 2012, including the buff octagonal tower, glass lantern, gallery, cleaning room and short connecting passage. The separately mapped fog signal house, keepers’ houses and visitor center are distinct structures.

originalReview.notes: The June 2012 water-side view shows the octagonal buff shaft, glass lantern, dark roof and yellow cleaning room against the cliff.
The Minnesota Historical Society construction section shows the taper, tall glass lantern, gallery, watch room, cleaning room and relative heights.

quallaSearch.notes: Reviewed Qualla first. Selected the exact first-party CC0 exterior and Minnesota Historical Society public-domain construction drawing. The NOAA archive transfer was excluded because the image also carries a CC BY declaration. Used no supplemental imagery.
